skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator for two unlike denominators and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fraction-parts) that share a common denominator to obtain the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Mixed Number Decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number (or treat a whole number as whole + 0/d) into distinct whole and fractional parts so each can be subtracted independently.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (as d/d) from the whole part and add it to the fraction before subtracting again.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by shifting whole units out of the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify to Lowest Terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.
